visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair and a man with a shaved head stand outside in a bright nursery. The woman smiles broadly towards the camera, while the man looks away. They are surrounded by many small green pine trees. (2) A man wearing a salmon-colored shirt and light shorts walks through the garden center with an older man in a green sweater. They pass by large evergreens under bright natural daylight. (3) Indoors, a man struggles to pull a very large potted Christmas tree through a sliding glass door into a living room with wooden floors. A woman helps pull from the inside. (4) The couple decorates the tree with string lights and ornaments. The man stands on a decorative stool to reach higher branches while the woman hangs items below. (5) A young girl in a blue leotard enters a hallway and stops, her mouth wide open in surprise. A young boy in a dark sweater follows her. They both run toward the tree with hands raised. (6) The children jump and dance around the tree and wrapped gifts. The woman and man from the first scene reappear in a close-up, smiling and looking proud of the decorated tree.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice speaks Mandarin over upbeat, medium-tempo electronic pop BGM. The tone is cheerful and bright. (2) Vocal shift as an adult male voice is heard briefly in the distance, blended with the rhythmic BGM. (3) Audible low-frequency thud and sliding sounds indicate heavy object movement, followed by strained grunts from a male voice. (4) Sound of light strings rustling and soft plastic clicks. Voices switch to a conversational mix of English and Portuguese with playful intonations. (5) A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. Adult voices discuss names like 'Tom Cruise' with laughter. (6) High-arousal, high-pitched scream from a child followed by gasping. The BGM swells slightly as the speech-to-music ratio shifts. (7) Intense, overlapping child laughter and shouting, reaching high peak volumes. Sounds of feet jumping on wood floors. (8) Transition to calm, warm adult dialogue. The BGM continues steadily before a clean cut ending.
